description: This file is a Bash shell script for generating FIT image tree source files for Qualcomm SDK sysupgrade images. It creates device tree source (DTS) files describing firmware images based on provided image files and their names, compatible with the QSDK sysupgrade format, including validation and partitioning details.
external_methods: bash built-in functions such as [ ], shift, echo

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions and exits. Called when insufficient arguments are provided or input files do not exist.
